fusions.name: Steadied Squeeze
fusions.desc: Fires a steadied shot that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 10 tiles, and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Palm the Spur
fusions.desc: Fans 3 rounds off in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Recoil Mastery
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
